page_title: UNI 0-3 DOR | Union Berlin v Dortmund 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A player from Dortmund brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
90+3' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salih Ozcan replacing Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
90+3' Substitution. Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes way for Filippo Mane.
90+2' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Union Berlin! Play can continue.

90+1' Play continues despite the shouts by some Union Berlin players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Robert Hartmann interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will replace Janik Haberer.
84' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Jobe Bellingham laid the ball off to Maximilian Beier (Dortmund), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
83' Julian Ryerson sends a lofted pass into the box, Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) shows good awareness to connect with it but blazes his shot high over the crossbar.

81' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
79' The substitution is prepared. Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fabio Silva.
76' Here's the change. Aljoscha Kemlein leaves the pitch and Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
76' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Diogo Leite will be replaced by Oliver Burke (Union Berlin).
74' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
73' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
69' Substitution. Emre Can leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aaron Anselmino (Dortmund).
68' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle after Fabio Silva (Dortmund) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
66' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Josip Juranovic and he is replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin).
66' Today's match ends for Ilyas Ansah who will be replaced by Livan Burcu (Union Berlin).
59' Emre Can (Dortmund) picks up a yellow card.
56' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
53' 0 - 2 Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top right corner. The score is 0:2.
53' The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
51' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
50' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Ooh that was close! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
38' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) unleashed a poor free kick shot from far out. He intended to threaten the goalkeeper, but instead sent the ball high over the bar.
29' Gregor Kobel pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop an accurate header from the corner kick by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) going in the bottom right corner.
28' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.
26' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
21' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
20' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) brings his opponent down. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
19' What a great touch by Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
16' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header!
16' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
14' Dortmund earn a corner.

12' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Frederik Ronnow. This effort really didn't trouble him.
10' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Emre Can (Dortmund) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Frederik Ronnow into the bottom left corner.
9' Emre Can (Dortmund) is going to take the penalty!
9' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' The referee blows his whistle and points to the penalty spot. A penalty kick will be taken.
7' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Hartmann who sees an offensive foul.
6' The free kick into the box finds Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin), who heads the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
